title: Color Collection · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Color Collection · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a color visible in the room. The lead identifies three different objects that visibly include the selected color. The group can see the color on all three objects. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Color Collection, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group can see the color on all three objects.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The group can see the color on all three objects.
